questions.q: Each of the letters in the word STUDENT is arranged in alphabetical order. How many letters are there in the English alphabetical series between the letter that is second from the left and the one that is fourth from the right in the new letter-cluster formed?
questions.s:
The logic followed here is: 

Given Word: STUDENT
 
According to the question, arraged in alphabetical order → D E N S T T U
 
So, Letter second from the left → E → 5
 
And,
 
Letter fourth from the right → S → 19
 

Thus, the number of letters between the letter that is second from the left and the one that is fourth from the right in the new letter-cluster formed → (S)19 − (E)5 − 1= 13

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"

questions.q: Which of the following statements best captures the essence of "Landscapes of Loss: The Story of an Indian Drought" by Kavitha Iyer?
o: A study on drought's human and ecological impacts in India.
A fictional story about a family in a drought-hit area.
A history of monsoon patterns and ancient agriculture in India.
A colonial-era policy analysis of water management.
questions.s:
The Correct answer is A study on drought's human and ecological impacts in India.

Key Points

  • "Landscapes of Loss: The Story of an Indian Drought" by Kavitha Iyer focuses on the human and ecological consequences of droughts in India.
  • The book sheds light on the socio-economic impact of droughts on rural communities, particularly farmers, and their families.
  • It explores how droughts lead to migrations, loss of livelihoods, and challenges related to water scarcity.
  • The narrative highlights the struggles faced by rural India, delving into the personal stories of individuals and communities.
  • It discusses the ecological ramifications of droughts, including degradation of land and water resources.
  • The book advocates for sustainable water management and policy reforms to address these recurring issues in India.
  • Kavitha Iyer, as a journalist, uses her expertise to provide an in-depth analysis of drought's impact on India's agrarian landscape.

Additional Information

  • Option 2: A fictional story about a family in a drought-hit area
    • The book is not fictional. It is a non-fictional account based on real events and experiences.
    • It uses journalistic tools to highlight the real plight of communities facing droughts in India.
  • Option 3: A history of monsoon patterns and ancient agriculture in India
    • While the book discusses water scarcity and droughts, it does not focus on the historical aspects of monsoon patterns or ancient agriculture.
    • The primary focus is on modern-day droughts and their impact on communities.
  • Option 4: A colonial-era policy analysis of water management
    • The book does not explore colonial-era water policies; its emphasis is on contemporary issues related to drought and water scarcity.

questions.q: There are 160 multiple choice questions in a test. 4 marks are allotted for a correct answer and 1 mark is deducted for a wrong answer or un-attempted question from the total score of correct answers. If a candidate scored 400 marks in the test, how many questions did he answer correctly?
questions.s:
Shortcut Trick

If all questions were answered correctly, the total score would be 160 × 4 = 640 marks.

The total marks lost from the maximum possible score = 640 − 400 = 240 marks.

Marks lost per incorrect or un-attempted question = 4 (for correct) + 1 (penalty) = 5 marks.

Number of incorrect or un-attempted questions = 240 ÷ 5 = 48.

Number of correctly answered questions = 160 − 48 = 112.

∴ The correct answer is 112 questions.

Alternate Method

Given:

Total questions = 160

Marks for a correct answer = +4

Marks for a wrong or un-attempted answer = −1

Total score obtained = 400 marks

Method Used: Alligation

⇒ If all 160 questions are correct, total score = 160 × 4 = +640

⇒ If all 160 questions are wrong or un-attempted, total score = 160 × (−1) = −160

⇒ The ratio of Correct to Wrong questions = 560 : 240 = 7 : 3

⇒ Total ratio parts = 7 + 3 = 10 parts

⇒ 10 parts = 160 questions

⇒ 1 part = 160 ÷ 10 = 16 questions

⇒ Correct questions = 7 parts = 7 × 16 = 112 questions

∴ The correct answer is 112 questions.

Additional Information

Linear Equation Approach

Let the number of correct answers be x. Then the incorrect or un-attempted answers will be (160 − x). The equation is formulated as 4x − 1(160 − x) = 400.

Rule of Alligation

It is a quick cross-multiplication visual method used to find the ratio in which two components of different values are combined to produce a specific average overall value.

Penalty Mark Evaluation

In negative marking exams, each mistake causes a total loss equal to the correct mark plus the penalty mark. For example, in this case, the total loss per error is 4 + 1 = 5 marks.

questions.q: An amount is said to double in 5 years with compound interest. How many years will it take for the amount to grow to 8 times its original value?
questions.s:
Given:

Amount doubles in 5 years

Compound Interest

Formula used:

If amount doubles: A = P × 2

For n times growth: A = P × (2)k

Calculations:

⇒ In 5 years, Amount = 2P

⇒ In 10 years, Amount = 4P

⇒ In 15 years, Amount = 8P

∴ The amount will become 8 times in 15 years.

questions.q:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The choir began the introit at the priest's signal.
o: The child sang the introit during the intermission.
The introit was replaced by an organ improvisation.
The missal included Latin text for the introit.
The cantor rehearsed the Sunday introit.
questions.s:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. The child sang the introit during the intermission.

Key Points

  • The given word "introit" refers to an introductory part of a religious ceremony, specifically a psalm or antiphon sung while the priest approaches the altar for the Eucharist. (प्रवेश भजन)
    • Example: The choir began the introit at the priest's signal.
  • The correct word is the homonym "introit", which in a non-liturgical or secular context, shifts its meaning to refer generally to an introductory musical piece or a vocal performance played during a secular event or intermission. (परिचय गान / प्रवेश संगीत)
    • Example: The child sang the introit during the intermission.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is- Option 1

Additional Information

Here are the remaining options explained along with their Hindi meanings in brackets:

  • Option 2: The introit was replaced by an organ improvisation. (प्रवेश भजन को ऑर्गन के संगीत से बदल दिया गया।): In this sentence, the word retains its strict religious meaning as a part of the church service.
  • Option 3: The missal included Latin text for the introit. (मिसल में प्रवेश भजन के लिए लैटिन पाठ शामिल था।): A missal is a liturgical book, so the word here is used in its original religious context.
  • Option 4: The cantor rehearsed the Sunday introit. (कैंटर ने रविवार के प्रवेश भजन का अभ्यास किया।): A cantor is a church official, maintaining the original liturgical meaning of the word.

Which of the following statements best reflects the Mantle Plume Hypothesis and its implications in explaining intraplate volcanism and hotspot tracks, particularly in contrast to plate boundary processes? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन मेंटल प्लम परिकल्पना (Mantle Plume Hypothesis) और इंट्राप्लेट ज्वालामुखी तथा हॉटस्पॉट ट्रैक को समझाने में इसके निहितार्थ को सबसे अच्छी तरह दर्शाता है, विशेष रूप से प्लेट सीमा प्रक्रियाओं के विपरीत? [DP HCM 2025, 09 Jan 2026, Shift-1]
o: Mantle plumes are narrow, buoyant columns of cold material rising from the upper mantle, forming island arcs and rift valleys primarily at divergent plate boundaries. / मेंटल प्लम ठंडी सामग्री के संकीर्ण, उत्प्लावक स्तंभ हैं जो ऊपरी मेंटल से उठते हैं, जो मुख्य रूप से अपसारी प्लेट सीमाओं पर द्वीप चाप और दरार घाटियाँ बनाते हैं।

Mantle plumes originate from the asthenosphere, are stationary with respect to tectonic plates, and are responsible for features like the Mid-Atlantic Ridge and Mariana Trench. / मेंटल प्लम एस्थेनोस्फीयर से उत्पन्न होते हैं, विवर्तनिक प्लेटों के संबंध में स्थिर होते हैं, और मिड-अटलांटिक रिज और मारियाना ट्रेंच जैसी विशेषताओं के लिए जिम्मेदार हैं।

Mantle plumes explain the episodic movement of tectonic plates by generating subduction zones, but cannot account for surface volcanic activity due to their low thermal energy. / मेंटल प्लम सबडक्शन ज़ोन उत्पन्न करके विवर्तनिक प्लेटों के प्रासंगिक आंदोलन की व्याख्या करते हैं, लेकिन उनकी कम तापीय ऊर्जा के कारण सतह की ज्वालामुखी गतिविधि के लिए जिम्मेदार नहीं हो सकते हैं।

Mantle plumes are deep-seated thermal anomalies, possibly rising from the core-mantle boundary, causing hotspot volcanism like the Hawaiian chain, independent of plate margins.  / मेंटल प्लम गहरे बैठे तापीय विसंगतियां हैं, जो संभवतः कोर-मेंटल सीमा से उठती हैं, जो प्लेट मार्जिन से स्वतंत्र हवाईयन श्रृंखला की तरह हॉटस्पॉट ज्वालामुखी का कारण बनती हैं।
questions.s: The groundbreaking Mantle Plume hypothesis, profoundly proposed by J. Tuzo Wilson, scientifically posits that narrow, exceptionally hot columns of molten magma actively rise from incredibly deep within the Earth, likely originating right at the extreme core-mantle boundary. These massive thermal plumes violently pierce through moving lithospheric tectonic plates to uniquely create isolated "hotspots" like Hawaii, completely independent of normal plate boundaries. / जे. तुज़ो विल्सन द्वारा गहराई से प्रस्तावित अभूतपूर्व मेंटल प्लम परिकल्पना (Mantle Plume hypothesis), वैज्ञानिक रूप से मानती है कि पिघले हुए मैग्मा के संकीर्ण, असाधारण रूप से गर्म स्तंभ सक्रिय रूप से पृथ्वी के भीतर अविश्वसनीय रूप से गहराई से उठते हैं, जो संभवतः चरम कोर-मेंटल सीमा पर उत्पन्न होते हैं। ये बड़े पैमाने पर थर्मल प्लम हवाई जैसे पृथक "हॉटस्पॉट" बनाने के लिए चलती लिथोस्फेरिक विवर्तनिक प्लेटों को हिंसक रूप से छेदते हैं, जो सामान्य प्लेट सीमाओं से पूरी तरह स्वतंत्र हैं।

questions_hin.q_hi: Each of the letters in the word STUDENT is arranged in alphabetical order. How many letters are there in the English alphabetical series between the letter that is second from the left and the one that is fourth from the right in the new letter-cluster formed?

The logic followed here is: 

Given Word: STUDENT
 
According to the question, arraged in alphabetical order → D E N S T T U
 
So, Letter second from the left → E → 5
 
And,
 
Letter fourth from the right → S → 19
 

Thus, the number of letters between the letter that is second from the left and the one that is fourth from the right in the new letter-cluster formed → (S)19 − (E)5 − 1= 13

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"

questions_hin.q_hi: There are 160 multiple choice questions in a test. 4 marks are allotted for a correct answer and 1 mark is deducted for a wrong answer or un-attempted question from the total score of correct answers. If a candidate scored 400 marks in the test, how many questions did he answer correctly?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Shortcut Trick

If all questions were answered correctly, the total score would be 160 × 4 = 640 marks.

The total marks lost from the maximum possible score = 640 − 400 = 240 marks.

Marks lost per incorrect or un-attempted question = 4 (for correct) + 1 (penalty) = 5 marks.

Number of incorrect or un-attempted questions = 240 ÷ 5 = 48.

Number of correctly answered questions = 160 − 48 = 112.

∴ The correct answer is 112 questions.

Alternate Method

Given:

Total questions = 160

Marks for a correct answer = +4

Marks for a wrong or un-attempted answer = −1

Total score obtained = 400 marks

Method Used: Alligation

⇒ If all 160 questions are correct, total score = 160 × 4 = +640

⇒ If all 160 questions are wrong or un-attempted, total score = 160 × (−1) = −160

⇒ The ratio of Correct to Wrong questions = 560 : 240 = 7 : 3

⇒ Total ratio parts = 7 + 3 = 10 parts

⇒ 10 parts = 160 questions

⇒ 1 part = 160 ÷ 10 = 16 questions

⇒ Correct questions = 7 parts = 7 × 16 = 112 questions

∴ The correct answer is 112 questions.

Additional Information

Linear Equation Approach

Let the number of correct answers be x. Then the incorrect or un-attempted answers will be (160 − x). The equation is formulated as 4x − 1(160 − x) = 400.

Rule of Alligation

It is a quick cross-multiplication visual method used to find the ratio in which two components of different values are combined to produce a specific average overall value.

Penalty Mark Evaluation

In negative marking exams, each mistake causes a total loss equal to the correct mark plus the penalty mark. For example, in this case, the total loss per error is 4 + 1 = 5 marks.

Amount doubles in 5 years

Compound Interest

[DP HCM 2025, 09 Jan 2026, Shift-1]
o_hi: Mantle plumes are narrow, buoyant columns of cold material rising from the upper mantle, forming island arcs and rift valleys primarily at divergent plate boundaries. / मेंटल प्लम ठंडी सामग्री के संकीर्ण, उत्प्लावक स्तंभ हैं जो ऊपरी मेंटल से उठते हैं, जो मुख्य रूप से अपसारी प्लेट सीमाओं पर द्वीप चाप और दरार घाटियाँ बनाते हैं।

Mantle plumes originate from the asthenosphere, are stationary with respect to tectonic plates, and are responsible for features like the Mid-Atlantic Ridge and Mariana Trench. / मेंटल प्लम एस्थेनोस्फीयर से उत्पन्न होते हैं, विवर्तनिक प्लेटों के संबंध में स्थिर होते हैं, और मिड-अटलांटिक रिज और मारियाना ट्रेंच जैसी विशेषताओं के लिए जिम्मेदार हैं।

Mantle plumes explain the episodic movement of tectonic plates by generating subduction zones, but cannot account for surface volcanic activity due to their low thermal energy. / मेंटल प्लम सबडक्शन ज़ोन उत्पन्न करके विवर्तनिक प्लेटों के प्रासंगिक आंदोलन की व्याख्या करते हैं, लेकिन उनकी कम तापीय ऊर्जा के कारण सतह की ज्वालामुखी गतिविधि के लिए जिम्मेदार नहीं हो सकते हैं।

Mantle plumes are deep-seated thermal anomalies, possibly rising from the core-mantle boundary, causing hotspot volcanism like the Hawaiian chain, independent of plate margins.  / मेंटल प्लम गहरे बैठे तापीय विसंगतियां हैं, जो संभवतः कोर-मेंटल सीमा से उठती हैं, जो प्लेट मार्जिन से स्वतंत्र हवाईयन श्रृंखला की तरह हॉटस्पॉट ज्वालामुखी का कारण बनती हैं।
questions_hin.s_hi: The groundbreaking Mantle Plume hypothesis, profoundly proposed by J. Tuzo Wilson, scientifically posits that narrow, exceptionally hot columns of molten magma actively rise from incredibly deep within the Earth, likely originating right at the extreme core-mantle boundary. These massive thermal plumes violently pierce through moving lithospheric tectonic plates to uniquely create isolated "hotspots" like Hawaii, completely independent of normal plate boundaries. / जे. तुज़ो विल्सन द्वारा गहराई से प्रस्तावित अभूतपूर्व मेंटल प्लम परिकल्पना (Mantle Plume hypothesis), वैज्ञानिक रूप से मानती है कि पिघले हुए मैग्मा के संकीर्ण, असाधारण रूप से गर्म स्तंभ सक्रिय रूप से पृथ्वी के भीतर अविश्वसनीय रूप से गहराई से उठते हैं, जो संभवतः चरम कोर-मेंटल सीमा पर उत्पन्न होते हैं। ये बड़े पैमाने पर थर्मल प्लम हवाई जैसे पृथक "हॉटस्पॉट" बनाने के लिए चलती लिथोस्फेरिक विवर्तनिक प्लेटों को हिंसक रूप से छेदते हैं, जो सामान्य प्लेट सीमाओं से पूरी तरह स्वतंत्र हैं।

questions_hin.q_hi: Q36. A caldera is best described as what type of geological feature, formed when a volcanic magma chamber empties and collapses? / एक काल्डेरा (caldera) को किस प्रकार की भूवैज्ञानिक विशेषता के रूप में सबसे अच्छी तरह वर्णित किया जा सकता है, जो तब बनता है जब ज्वालामुखीय मैग्मा कक्ष खाली हो जाता है और ढह जाता है? [Delhi Police Constable, 05 Jan 2026, Shift-1]
o_hi: Small cone-shaped volcano / छोटा शंकु के आकार का ज्वालामुखी
Submarine trench / पनडुब्बी खाई (Submarine trench)
Lava plateau / लावा पठार
Large volcanic crater formed after collapse of a magma chamber  / मैग्मा कक्ष के ढहने के बाद बना बड़ा ज्वालामुखी क्रेटर
questions_hin.s_hi: In advanced scientific volcanology, a 'Caldera' is strictly and definitively defined as an absolutely enormous, deep basin-like volcanic depression (a super-crater). It is critically not formed simply directly by an explosive blast, but rather by the catastrophic, violent inward collapse of a massive entire volcano's heavy structural roof plummeting deeply into its own totally emptied magma chamber. / उन्नत वैज्ञानिक ज्वालामुखिकी में, एक 'काल्डेरा' (Caldera) को कड़ाई से और निश्चित रूप से एक बिल्कुल विशाल, गहरे बेसिन जैसे ज्वालामुखी अवसाद (एक सुपर-क्रेटर) के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है। यह गंभीर रूप से केवल एक विस्फोटक विस्फोट द्वारा सीधे नहीं बनता है, बल्कि एक विशाल पूरे ज्वालामुखी की भारी संरचनात्मक छत के अपने ही पूरी तरह से खाली मैग्मा कक्ष में गहराई से गिरने के विनाशकारी, हिंसक आवक पतन से बनता है।
